¿Cómo funciona la firma por link?: How does signing by link work?
Tocá “Enviar a firmar”, escribí el nombr: Tap “Send for signature”, type the other person's name and share the link with them. They open the contract, read it (they can even translate it), draw their signature and that's it: the signature appears on your contract.
¿Qué hace la revisión con IA?: What does the AI review do?
Le da un puntaje a tu contrato, te lo ex: It scores your contract, explains it in plain words, and tells you which clauses are missing and what risks it has. You can add the missing clauses in one click.
¿Puedo volver a una versión anterior?: Can I go back to an earlier version?
Sí. Cada cambio importante (generar, edi: Yes. Every important change (generating, editing with AI, translating, signing) creates a version you can view and restore from “Versions”.
Sí. En “Enviar a firmar” agregás a todas: Yes. In “Send for signature” you add everyone (up to 8) and, if you want, have them sign in order. If you add their email, they get the invitation and a reminder every 3 days.
Una página que se agrega al PDF con quié: A page added to the PDF showing who signed, when, from which device, and the document's digital fingerprint. If someone changes the text after signing, the certificate detects it.
¿La otra parte puede pedir cambios?: Can the other party request changes?
Sí. Desde su link puede seleccionar una: Yes. From their link they can select part of the contract and leave a comment. You get a notice, reply, and mark the request as resolved.
Guardás cualquier contrato como plantill: You save any contract as a template and Lacey replaces the details (names, amounts, dates) with fields. Next time you just fill in those fields and you're done.

¿Cómo funcionan los avisos de vencimient: How do due date reminders work?
